import random
rnd = random.Random(41)
bal = 0
t = []
for i in range(100000):
    rem = 100000 - i
    if bal == 0 or (bal < rem and rnd.random() < 0.5):
        t.append('('); bal += 1
    else:
        t.append(')'); bal -= 1
s = ''.join(c if rnd.random() < 0.6 else '?' for c in t)
result = sol.smallest_balanced(s)
